title: Christ Church Cathedral (Montreal)
geometryBasis: Exact named mapped perimeter and street orientation, with the published 61.87 by 33.22 metre envelope and 69.80 metre spire.
sectionBasis: The published Detroit photograph shows the Gothic mass, gray stone, steep gables and spire taper. The cathedral records the three entrance arches, rose window, limestone recladding and lighter 1940 aluminum spire.
limitations: Tracery, carved bosses and stone block sizes are approximate. The model includes the exposed exterior and replacement spire above grade.
The underground mall, current support pillars below grade and surrounding modern office buildings are outside the model.
